summary: Renders text into a TOP image from direct text, DAT/spec DAT sources, Field COMP text, or CHOP value replacement, with font, layout, and compositing controls.

key_params.name: fontfile
key_params.note: TrueType/OpenType font file; disables the font menu.

key_params.name: dispmethod
key_params.note: Automatic, polygon, stroke, bitmap, or scalable rendering.

key_params.name: compoverinput
key_params.note: Composite generated text over the input.

common_gotchas: Legacy Parsing is deprecated; use expression-mode Python strings for escapes such as newline and tab.
Font File disables the installed-font menu and should point directly at a .ttf or .otf when portability matters.
Word wrap and auto-fit interact in two stages, so text can resize or wrap differently than expected.
Specification DAT column headers must use parameter names and each row can override placement/layout values.
Comp Over Input exposes full compositing behavior, including operand and swap-order controls.
key_concepts: Text TOP renders strings into an image and supports TrueType/OpenType fonts, Unicode text, and scalable Slug rendering.
Text can come from the Text parameter, a DAT cell, a Field COMP, a Specification DAT, or CHOP value replacement.
Specification DAT workflows use parameter-name column headers and pixel-position style per-row settings.
Font display method, antialiasing, auto-fit, alignment, tracking, borders, and output compositing all affect the generated texture.
